name: Prayer Flags
desc: Lines of Tibetan lung-ta prayer flags strung between poles in the five elemental colours, the cloth fluttering so a wind wave travels the row while the free edges ripple and fray; strung across a diagonal band that leaves the rest of the frame open — sun-bleached weathered cloth, fresh vivid colour, sumi silhouettes, a two-ink riso, or a schematic line.

energy.doc: cloth lighting and the amplitude of the flutter

scale.doc: flag size — min small pennants, max big banners

density.doc: how many lines (2 to 5) and how many flags on each

speed.doc: how fast the wind flutters the cloth

wind.doc: wind strength — line sway, sag and how hard the flags snap and ripple

hue.doc: shifts the whole five-colour set toward this hue

x.doc: centre of the band across frame

y.doc: height of the band so the rest of the frame stays open

style.doc: aesthetic: sun-bleached faded cloth with woodblock mantra rows / fresh saturated five-colour / sumi-black silhouettes / a two-ink riso / a cyan schematic line

seed.doc: wind lottery — per-line droop, sag phase and per-flag flutter phase and bleach

alpha.doc: layer opacity — scales every mark so it dissolves into the background rather than veiling it
